def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 7]
    if len(pts) >= 2:
        (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = sorted(pts)
        dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
        # Extend the diagonal line from the upper-left marker away from the other.
        r, c = r1 - dr, c1 - dc
        while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
            if grid[r][c] == grid[0][0]:
                out[r][c] = 7
            r -= dr
            c -= dc
    return out
